description: Price a buying list (up to 100 lines / 20 KB): product names or EANs, quantities in cases and optional target prices. Paste it as text (one product per line, or CSV/TSV with a header row) or give structured lines. Each line comes back with a match status (matched, ambiguous, not_listed, moq_not_met, insufficient_stock, price_unavailable), the listed price, pack, stock, duty status, Incoterm and line total. Lines keep their own currency (EUR, USD or GBP); totals are subtotals per currency, never converted or summed across currencies.

duty_status.description: Duty status as listed. T1 = non-EU (third-country) status goods under customs transit; T2 = EU-status goods that can move within the EU under excise duty suspension (e.g. with an eAD in EMCS). Both T1 and T2 are held in bond with duty suspended: neither is duty paid. Bonded, On Floor and Duty Paid are shown exactly as listed on akay.ie.

product.description: Product name as the buyer wrote it, e.g. "Jameson 6x70cl T2"

target_basis.description: Whether the target price is per case or per unit

target_price.description: Buyer's target price, compared only when currency and basis are given

text.description: The pasted list, e.g. "Jameson 6x70cl T2 - 200 cases" per line, or CSV with a header row
